title: The Borough Treasurer
description: A mystery novel involving blackmail, murder, and the uncovering of past identities in the small town of Highmarket. The story revolves around the murder of an ex-detective, Burnett, and the subsequent investigation that reveals dark secrets about the town's prominent figures.
intro_narrative: Halfway along the north side of Highmarket's main street stands an ancient stone gateway leading to the yard of Mallalieu and Hill, Builders and Contractors. One October afternoon, Milford Hill, the Borough Treasurer, receives a visit from his new tenant, Burnett, who reveals a shocking secret from Hill's past. Burnett, an ex-detective, recognizes Hill and his partner, Anthony Sandler, as the men he saw convicted for fraud thirty years prior at Criss Assizes. Burnett threatens to expose their past unless they pay him off. This revelation sets off a chain of events leading to Burnett's murder and the unraveling of long-buried secrets.
